name: Stack Z-Projection Statistical Comparison
description:
You are a neuroimaging researcher comparing data reduction methods. Your task is to analyze the statistical properties of different Z-projection methods on a brain MRI volume.

1. Open the built-in 'MRI Stack' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > MRI Stack).
2. Generate five different Z-projections of the stack using Image > Stacks > Z Project:
   - Max Intensity
   - Average Intensity
   - Min Intensity
   - Sum Slices
   - Standard Deviation
3. For EACH projection, measure the image statistics (Mean, StdDev, Min, Max).
4. Compile these statistics into a single CSV file saved to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/zprojection_comparison.csv'. The CSV must have columns for 'Projection_Type', 'Mean', 'StdDev', 'Min', and 'Max'.
5. Save the 'Standard Deviation' projection image itself as a TIFF file to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/stddev_projection.tif'.
